noIncome: No income recorded this period yet
noIncomeBody: Record your salary to see what is safe to spend each day.
salaryMissing: Payday has passed and no salary is recorded yet. The period started on the scheduled date.
sanity: Your spending accounts hold less than what is left to spend plus unpaid bills. Something may not be recorded yet.
extraIncome: Extra income this period raised your spending money. Put some of it toward a goal?
leftover: The period ends soon with {amount} left. Move it to a goal?
emptyBody: Add the accounts you use, then record your salary.

cups.label: Day cups for this period: day {day} of {days}. {over, plural, =0 {No day went over its share yet.} one {One day went over its share.} other {# days went over their share.}} Use the left and right arrows to see each day.

why.title: Why this number?
why.note: Transfers between your own accounts do not count. Card purchases count on the day you make them.

steps.title: Getting started ({done}/{total})
steps.accountBody: Bank, e-wallet or cash, with today's balance.
steps.incomeBody: The daily number is worked out from it.
steps.billsBody: Rent, power, instalments. They come off before the daily split.
steps.goalBody: An emergency fund, for example. Set aside on every payday.

recentEmpty: Type your first expense in the bar below, for example "coffee 25k".
